headline: Playing time refreshes until kickoff.
whyNotKnown: Game-day actives are published about 90 minutes before kickoff; until then availability comes from the injury report.
whatWeDoInstead: Each player carries a range of his team's work, not a single number, and the share nobody on the list accounts for is published as unallocated.
whyItMatters: A projection is only as good as the playing-time behind it.

states.AVAILABLE_ROLE_UNCERTAIN: every named player on this slate
